# Stories Hotel Budapest

> Stories Hotel Budapest is a four-star, 44-room boutique hotel at Király utca 26, 1061 Budapest, Hungary, in the Twenty Six building in the Jewish Quarter of District VI. It opened in 2019 and is also listed as Stories Boutique Hotel.

Stories Hotel Budapest is operated by Secret Hotel Kft. Reception is staffed 24 hours a day. Check-in is from 15:00 and check-out is by 11:00.

## Contact

- Telephone: +36 1 808 0980
- WhatsApp: +36 20 318 0027
- E-mail: info@storiesbudapest.com
- Address: Király utca 26, 1061 Budapest, Hungary (Twenty Six building)

## Rooms

Stories Hotel Budapest has 44 rooms in six types:

- Presidential Suite: 165–180 m², three floors, two king beds, 2.5 bathrooms, private sauna and Jacuzzi, sleeps up to 6.
- King Suite: 85 m², king bed, Jacuzzi tub, private sauna, rainfall shower, spacious living area.
- Junior Suite: 65–75 m², a duplex with a king bed on the mezzanine and a sofa bed below, sleeps up to 4. Four colour variants.
- Deluxe Room: 34–45 m², king bed and sitting area. Four colour variants.
- Deluxe Queen Room: 30 m², queen bed, faces the inner courtyard, sleeps up to 2.
- Superior Room: 17 m², queen bed. Two colour variants.

The Presidential Suite and the King Suite each have a private Jacuzzi and a private sauna.

## In the building

- Breakfast is served 07:30–11:00 daily at the Twenty Six restaurant on the ground floor. It is à la carte and is not included in the room rate; reception gives the current price.
- The bar and lounge is open 17:00 to midnight every day and extends into the inner courtyard on warm evenings.
- Create 26 is a coworking floor inside the Twenty Six building. It is run by a separate company and is not included in the room rate; the hotel sells access at reception. Open Monday to Friday, 09:00–17:00.
- WiFi is free throughout the building. Luggage storage is available before check-in and after check-out.

## Nearby

- GoActive gym is a five-minute walk from the hotel, with Technogym equipment and a sauna. It is run by a separate company and is not included in the room rate; the hotel sells access at reception.
- The hotel is in the Jewish Quarter, a ten-minute walk from Vörösmarty tér.
- Metro line 1 (Opera station) and metro line 2 (Deák Ferenc tér) are each a five-minute walk away. Buses 9, 16 and 105 stop seven minutes away.
- Budapest Liszt Ferenc Airport is about 35 minutes by taxi, typically €30–35. The 100E airport bus runs to Deák Ferenc tér. The hotel can book a car through its transfer partner.

## Policies

- Cancellation: free up to 5 days before arrival. Cancellations within 5 days, and no-shows, are charged in full. Non-refundable rates follow their own conditions.
- Pets are not allowed.
- Smoking is prohibited in all enclosed spaces, including the rooms.
- Children under 16 must be supervised by an adult at all times.
- There is a lift. Some rooms have steps of their own; guests who need a room without stairs should contact reception before booking.
- The hotel has no car park of its own; there is paid parking nearby.
- There is no minimum stay. Group bookings, up to the whole 44-room house, are subject to availability.
- The best rate is the one on the hotel's own website, where bookings go through the SabeeApp booking engine.
- Room rates and breakfast prices are not published on the website.
